Class ScenarioCustomEngineHandler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioCustomEngineHandler
public class ScenarioCustomEngineHandler extends Object

Scenario Custom Engine Handler

Modular handler for custom and Tier-1 physical law engine export/import, on-the-fly dynamic compilation, and UI binding injection.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
